headerDisplay: Connects an Akuvox SmartPlus intercom to HomeKit. Use a dedicated family-member account, not your personal login. After saving, run `akuvox-pair` once over SSH to complete the emailed-code sign-in, then restart Homebridge.

email.title: SmartPlus account email (optional)
email.description: Leave blank to keep credentials out of config.json; akuvox-pair will prompt. Setting it enables automatic re-login if the token ever fully expires.

unlockSeconds.title: Relock delay (seconds)
unlockSeconds.description: How long the HomeKit lock shows Unlocked before snapping back to Secured.

doorbell.title: Enable doorbell rings (SIP)
doorbell.description: Register on the intercom PBX to get real-time ring notifications.
